test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: **In what way have the prize winners helped the future theoretical computer scientists?**

options.text: They solved new problems in graph theory used in theoretical computer science.
The new connection they have discovered has inspired future theoretical computer scientists.
They have found connections between algebra, geometry and computer science.
They have done innovative research on Ramanujan graphs and geometry of polynomials.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The new connection they have discovered has inspired future theoretical computer scientists.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The second paragraph of the given passage states that,
 
 
• *"Marcus, Spielman and Srivastava solved longstanding questions on the Kadison-Singer problem and on Ramanujan graphs, **and in the process uncovered a deep new connection between linear algebra, geometry of polynomials, and graph theory that has inspired the next generation of theoretical computer scientists,__**" the NAS said in a statement.*
 
 
 
• *​*The unlined part of the above paragraph clears that by making new linkages between algebra, geometry, and computer science, the award winners aided the next generation of theoretical computer scientists.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**
